inputs_reviewed: Only packet.json and its 25 listed validation photos; no test assets or other run outputs.
method: Inspected every supplied photo. Evaluate combined brand/product identity, allowing case/punctuation, reordered names, printed neutral wording, and brand/range partitioning when all identifying content is preserved. Missing or conflicting distinguishing identity fails. Uncertain cases count as failures. Exact-volume correctness is paired from the unchanged packet flag, independently consistent with the viewed labels; no tolerance or inferred consumption.
scope: Secondary validation-only human-style photo/wording diagnostic; cannot establish target success, replace frozen primary scoring, alter aliases/references, or support a final-test claim.
